question-assets/foreign-exchange-market/.imageAlt: Dollar demand and upward-sloping supply both shift right, from D0 and S0 to D1 and S1.
question-assets/foreign-exchange-market/.graphDescription: The vertical axis is foreign currency per U.S. dollar and the horizontal axis is the quantity of dollars exchanged. Demand and supply both shift right. Original equilibrium A is quantity 100 and rate 1.0; final equilibrium B is quantity 200 and rate 1.0. Solid curves are D0 and S0; dashed curves are D1 and S1. D1 crosses S0 at approximately quantity 150 and rate 1.2; D0 crosses S1 at approximately quantity 150 and rate 0.8. These two crossings have no point labels or dashed coordinate guides.
